description: A message held for a chat: when it can be sent, and when sending or deleting it is refused.

messages.after_turn: It can be sent once this turn's over
messages.while_exhausted: It can't be sent while this chat's context is exhausted: pick a model with a bigger window, or clear it
messages.while_down: It can't be sent while the connection to this chat's host is down
messages.while_no_host: It can't be sent while this chat's host isn't there
messages.while_disabled: It can't be sent while this chat's subscription is disabled
messages.while_other: It can't be sent while nothing can be sent in this chat
